notes: The nine trades of the Daggerfall flow, transcribed from docs/design/CHARGEN-DAGGERFALL-DRAFT.md section 2 (the approved roster: Bondsworn out, Copy-Clerk in). Each sheet fills 3 Primary / 3 Major / up to 6 Minor -- a short Minor row is legal and unpenalized. Attribute spends each sum to exactly 24 with no value over 15, over base 40. Axis codes are the doc's own (dominant/secondary): A honest labor, B indirection and the tide, C letters and doctrine. The owner line-edits the doc; a sync pass moves his edits here.

callings.name: Dockhand
callings.oneLine: You carry what the ward eats and you are paid by dusk

callings.name: Deckhand
callings.oneLine: Honest hands on a hull that answers only to the tide
callings.note: skyrunning on the Major row: rigging is climbing, skills.json:88.

callings.name: Watch Runner
callings.oneLine: You carry the post's paper and stand where you are told
callings.note: kit_keeping is the Watch ladder's own skill (ranks.json:52); streetwise is what patrol trains (jobs.json:200); lancework per spear-dominant infantry canon (DOCKS-GAZETTEER.md:591).

callings.name: Netter
callings.oneLine: The tide does the work; you are there when it does
callings.anchor: Dockhands; the Netters' Company (chapters.json:53-63); maritime.fisher (jobs.json:273, trains fishing)
callings.note: kit_keeping on the Primary row is net-mending -- Grandmother Withy's own craft, notables.json:294.

callings.name: Mudlark
callings.oneLine: You walk the low water and you know what a thing is worth
callings.note: streetwise: black-market pricing is the skill's own text (skills.json:133); fishing is reading water (skills.json:169). Sixth Minor slot left empty -- a mudlark's sheet is honestly thin.

callings.name: Roof-Tenant
callings.oneLine: A quiet lodger the Watch has never had a reason to write down
callings.note: mixtures on the Minor row: nighthawk venom is roofs canon, skills.json:118. Sixth Minor slot empty.

callings.name: Almsbearer
callings.oneLine: You carry soup and doctrine to doors that distrust the garb
callings.anchor: Temple rank 2 title (ranks.json:45); clergy.acolyte (jobs.json:241, trains channeling)
callings.note: linkcraft is the Temple ladder's own skill (ranks.json:40); mixtures is draughts for the sick; fieldcraft is the Mission garden (DOCKS-GAZETTEER.md:120-123). Two Minor slots left empty -- the Mission does not pad a sheet.

callings.name: Stallkeep
callings.oneLine: A counter, a scale, and a price you will stand behind
callings.note: linkcraft on the Primary row: two sets of books means a lettered counter, notables.json:103.

callings.name: Copy-Clerk
callings.oneLine: You copy what the ward writes down and notice what it doesn't
callings.note: No clerk job exists in jobs.json yet; the calling anchors to the Merchant Row and the nearest real job (trade.trader, jobs.json:305) until one does. cracksmanship on the Major row: lockboxes and strongrooms are a clerk's furniture, DOCKS-GAZETTEER.md:92-94. Sixth Minor slot empty.
